scope: South Africa medical discovery — University of KwaZulu-Natal School of Clinical Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UKZN's School of Clinical Medicine offers MBChB and states that it is fully accredited by HPCSA.
UKZN's 2026 MBChB brochure states that international students are not considered, except for SADC-agreement applicants; it identifies currently reserved places from Lesotho.
UKZN's annual report records five-year MBChB accreditation by the Medical and Dental Professions Board after a March 2024 visit.

holdReasons: The MBChB is not a global international route: ordinary foreign applicants are excluded, with only the specified SADC-agreement exception.
No current SADC-route application process, fee schedule, intake dates or eligibility detail was established.
A restricted profile may be publishable only after the SADC route is precisely evidenced; no payload was created.
nextAction: If pursuing, obtain UKZN's current SADC-agreement MBChB admissions, fee and seat-allocation notice; otherwise leave this as an intentional exclusion.
